For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4. ABOUT THE COMPANY Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. Driven : We deliver results in the right way. Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need. Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America. Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year). jobs.description: L'opportunité Vous serez responsable d’une plateforme sur laquelle les équipes de développement de Unity comptent pour exploiter des services en production. Celle-ci leur fournit un environnement Kubernetes géré dans des grappes partagées afin qu’elles puissent déployer et exploiter des applications sans avoir à mettre en place leur propre infrastructure. Elle prend actuellement en charge plus de 1 200 déploiements actifs et traite environ 30 millions de requêtes entrantes en production par jour. Il s’agit d’un poste principal, et cette distinction est importante. Vous définirez l’orientation technique de la plateforme plutôt que de mettre en œuvre la conception de quelqu’un d’autre. Vous déterminerez la façon de gérer l’architecture multilocataire, l’isolation et la conformité dans les grappes partagées, ainsi que les fonctions que la plateforme doit ou ne doit pas offrir. Vous veillerez ensuite à concrétiser ces décisions en production. Votre jugement influencera la manière dont des centaines de développeur(euse)s chez Unity livrent leur code. L’équipe est répartie dans le monde entier, et les outils que nous créons constituent la base sur laquelle les autres équipes s’appuient pour mettre leur travail en production de façon sûre et rapide. Nous sommes convaincu(e)s que rien de valable ne se construit en vase clos. Ce que vous allez faire Assurer la responsabilité de l’architecture et de la fiabilité d’une plateforme Kubernetes multilocataire : isolation des locataires, application des politiques, contrôle des admissions, attribution des coûts, conformité à la loi SOX et mise à l’échelle des grappes partagées à mesure que leur adoption augmente. Concevoir et livrer des fonctionnalités de plateforme, de la proposition initiale jusqu’à l’exploitation en production. Parmi les exemples récents figurent la gestion des secrets avec Vault, l’application des politiques au moyen de Kyverno, la migration de nginx-ingress vers la Gateway API, la mise à l’échelle automatique axée sur les événements avec KEDA, les ressources Config Connector, un fournisseur d’identité dédié à l’authentification de la plateforme et l’attribution des coûts par espace de noms. Définir l’orientation de la normalisation de l’infrastructure infonuagique chez Unity : déterminer quelles charges de travail conviennent à une plateforme partagée, quelles solutions de rechange sont possibles et comment les équipes peuvent effectuer la transition. Collaborer avec la haute direction ainsi qu’avec les équipes partenaires responsables de l’expérience des développeur(euse)s, des réseaux, des FinOps, de la fiabilité et de la sécurité afin de façonner la feuille de route de la plateforme et de démontrer la pertinence d’y investir. Rehausser les normes de développement au sein de l’équipe grâce à l’examen de la conception et du code ainsi qu’au mentorat. Collaborer directement avec les équipes qui utilisent la plateforme afin de cerner leurs obstacles et de les transformer en améliorations à la plateforme plutôt qu’en interventions ponctuelles répétées. Participer à une rotation de garde pour la plateforme dont vous êtes responsable. Ce que nous recherchons Avoir conçu, créé et exploité une infrastructure multilocataire ou partagée à grande échelle, posséder une solide expérience pratique de Kubernetes et de l’infrastructure en tant que code, et avoir exploité en production les solutions que vous avez conçues. Posséder une solide expérience de GCP ainsi qu’une connaissance pratique d’au moins un autre fournisseur, soit AWS ou Azure. Comprendre les compromis liés aux services gérés et être en mesure de défendre une décision architecturale qui touche d’autres équipes que la vôtre. Avoir fait ses preuves dans la prise en charge complète de fonctionnalités de plateforme, notamment dans les domaines de la gestion des secrets, de l’application des politiques, des pipelines de déploiement, de l’identité, de l’attribution des coûts ou du renforcement de la sécurité. Savoir repérer les possibilités à l’échelle de la plateforme, proposer des solutions qui s’appliquent à plusieurs unités d’affaires et les mettre en œuvre avec un minimum de directives. Être en mesure de rédiger la proposition, de diriger la discussion technique et d’établir le consensus nécessaire. Adopter une approche axée sur le produit en matière d’infrastructure. Tenir compte de l’expérience des développeur(euse)s qui utilisent vos solutions et accorder la priorité aux travaux qui réduisent les obstacles et favorisent l’adoption des fonctions libre-service. Avoir aidé d’autres équipes à atteindre un haut niveau de résilience des services en transmettant des pratiques et en appliquant les principes de développement axés sur la fiabilité au moyen des outils que vous avez créés. Privilégier l’automatisation plutôt que le travail manuel et créer des systèmes reproductibles, observables et documentés. About the Role
We are makers.
We create because we are curious, and we believe that the best way to prove an idea works is to make it real.
As the
GCD, Scaled CRM & Performance

This is a transformation-focused senior leadership role built for a modern creative architect who understands how to build hard-working, high-velocity digital campaigns. You will oversee a cross-functional global team delivering thousands of performance-driven assets annually—including sophisticated lifecycle email ecosystems, B2B and B2C landing pages, performance marketing engines, and platform-native digital campaigns.
Your mandate is to elevate every transactional touchpoint to world-class excellence (clear, useful, human) while driving a culture of responsible automation. You will lead the consolidation of legacy creative teams across business units, stripping out manual friction to establish a modernized, tech-enabled model where human artistry meets machine speed. This role requires immense change management grit; you must possess the leadership presence and strategic stamina needed to restructure legacy teams, challenge defensive ways of working, and systematically transition a massive operational engine into an automated, AI-native future.
Responsibilities:
Systemic Brand & Performance Direction:
Enforce an uncompromising narrative and visual standard across all scaled channels. Ensure that high-volume, localized, and automated assets feel premium, clear, and contextually relevant.
Operational Overhaul & Program Architecture:
Partner directly with leadership across account, strategy, production and content innovation to establish comprehensive program management. Lead the structural evolution of the business by turning micro-processes into macro changes, moving the team away from fragmented, manual workflows.
Responsible Automation & Innovation Culture:
Partner with implementation engineers and technology leads to foster a culture of active experimentation, driving the integration of AI across all forms of creative output and ways of making. Oversee the scaled rollout of automated toolkits responsibly, ensuring that technology acts as a creative unlock to expand capabilities without compromising structural quality.
Uncompromising Artistry Standards:
Act as the ultimate gatekeeper for holistic craft across all creative disciplines. Ensure that copywriting, concept development, design standards, email best practices, typography, layout precision, motion graphics, and all other elements of textual and visual artistry are upheld to our highest creative standards, regardless of production volume.
Unified Vision & Senior Team Evolution:
Define the overarching creative roadmap and empower the senior creative leaders underneath you to actively champion it within their dedicated workstreams. Clearly separate high-level strategic vision from day-to-day project execution, ensuring your leadership layer is driving business growth and client confidence while holding teams accountable to a future-facing model.
Client Trust & Growth Portfolio:
Act as an authoritative strategic peer to client VPs and Product Marketing Directors (PMMs). Elevate the agency's relationship from a traditional execution utility to a trusted growth partner that proactively unlocks new digital marketing scopes.
About You
The essentials:
Senior Agency Leadership:
12+ years of experience leading cross-functional creative teams within top-tier digital agencies or tech-native brand organizations, with a proven track record managing large-scale global accounts.
Performance Marketing & CRM Mastery:
Deep expertise in the architecture of high-volume digital advertising, lifecycle email infrastructure, data-driven CRM systems, and UX/UI performance metrics.
Technical Literacy & "Maker" Mindset:
A forward-thinking leader who understands the mechanics of how work is made and has a proven interest in using AI suites, dynamic creative optimization (DCO), and automated toolkits to accelerate output.
Exceptional Craft & Precision:
A sharp eye for design, motion, and narrative structure. The ability to look at a highly structured B2B deck, a localized performance banner, or a complex email sequence and immediately identify how to elevate its artistic execution.
Change Management Grit:
The senior-level presence and emotional intelligence required to restructure legacy teams, disrupt long-standing production habits, and transition a massive operational engine into an automated, tech-enabled future.

Position Summary Join Marathon Petroleum as a Senior Business LAN Network Engineer and help shape the secure, reliable network infrastructure that keeps our refinery business operations connected and moving forward. In this highly visible role, you will lead the design, architecture, implementation, lifecycle management, and advanced support of business LAN environments across complex industrial sites, with strong emphasis on Layer 1 physical infrastructure, Layer 2 switching services, and practical Layer 3 integration. You will work on meaningful infrastructure challenges that directly support safe, reliable refinery operations while partnering with site IT, enterprise network engineering, cybersecurity, facilities, telecom providers, contractors, vendors, and business stakeholders. This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who wants to make a measurable impact in a collaborative, safety-focused organization that values integrity, inclusion, continuous improvement, and excellence. The successful candidate will influence LAN strategy and standards, strengthen resiliency, improve documentation and troubleshooting practices, mentor engineers, and drive outcomes in reliability, deployment speed, cost optimization, and operational risk reduction. If you enjoy solving complex problems, leading through influence, and building infrastructure that supports critical energy operations, this role offers the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a difference at Marathon Petroleum. Key Responsibilities Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and lifecycle management of refinery business LAN infrastructure, including switching, structured cabling, fiber, network closets, telecom spaces, and related Layer 1 and Layer 2 components. Develop and maintain LAN standards, reference designs, configuration baselines, cabling and labeling practices, resiliency patterns, and site implementation guidance. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex LAN incidents, recurring reliability issues, performance concerns, design gaps, and high-impact outages affecting refinery business operations. Troubleshoot and resolve Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues involving cabling, fiber, optics, patching, switch stacks, VLANs, trunks, spanning tree, link aggregation, port security, and access-layer performance. Support Layer 3 integration with routed uplinks, gateways, subnet coordination, DHCP relay, firewall interfaces, wireless connectivity, and enterprise routing handoffs. Lead LAN refreshes, lifecycle replacements, business expansion projects, construction support, office moves, turnaround planning, and remediation of aging infrastructure. Partner with cybersecurity teams to strengthen segmentation, secure switch management, NAC or 802.1X readiness, logging, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance. Maintain accurate technical documentation, including logical and physical diagrams, switchport records, patch panel mappings, fiber routes, VLAN assignments, inventories, rack elevations, and design decisions. Coordinate changes with refinery operations, facilities, vendors, contractors, telecom providers, cybersecurity, enterprise network teams, and business stakeholders to minimize operational disruption. Set monitoring thresholds, analyze traffic and utilization trends, tune performance, identify root causes, and proactively reduce recurring network issues. Evaluate network hardware, platforms, tools, and emerging technologies to improve reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, peer review, and guidance to engineers, site IT staff, contractors, and project teams while reinforcing safety, change control, cybersecurity, and operational risk management practices. Deploys complex network configurations for on-premise or cloud-based networks and assists in the development of playbooks for network systems. Assists in the integration of new systems and tools. Develops and maintains scripts to facilitate network administrative tasks and automate repetitive processes. Sets the requirements and thresholds for monitoring systems for network devices. Participates in troubleshooting sessions for network-related issues at all layers of the OSI model. Monitors performance, identifies areas for improvement for the network and implements performance tuning. Identifies trends in issues and determines the root cause to reduce future issues. Adheres to network policies, standards, and standard operating procedures for how-to documents. Undertakes the regular analysis and interpretation of traffic and utilization of services on network connections.
